description: Infrastructure, queries, and documentation: the full Terraform module under infra/terraform/ (valid HCL only, NOT applied), the Step Functions ASL template, the Athena example SQL against the gold Iceberg + audit tables, and all docs (top-level README + docs/*). Depends on the names, CLI contract, mart schemas, and audit schema settled by FEAT-001 and FEAT-002. terraform validate/fmt is SKIPPED (terraform absent); correctness here is by inspection against design §8/§9 and the FEAT-002 jobs. Keep POC-scale and heavily commented; no future scope.
steps: Create infra/terraform/versions.tf (terraform >= 1.6, required_providers aws ~> 5.x) and providers.tf (aws provider with default_tags = the FinOps map: Project=ocbc-poc, Environment=dev, CostCenter=data-platform-poc, Owner=solutions-eng, ManagedBy=terraform, DataClassification=confidential-pii).

Create infra/terraform/variables.tf (project, env, region, idle_timeout_minutes, max_cpu/mem/disk, lifecycle day counts, optional tag overrides) and locals.tf (name_prefix = project-env, deterministic bucket names with account id via data.aws_caller_identity, Glue DB names with underscores, tag map). Create terraform.tfvars.example with sane POC defaults.
Create infra/terraform/kms.tf: one aws_kms_key (rotation enabled) + aws_kms_alias alias/ocbc-poc-dev-datalake; key policy grants account root admin and the EMR + SFN roles encrypt/decrypt.

Create infra/terraform/s3.tf: two buckets (datalake, athena-results). For each add aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block (all four flags true), aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration (sse-kms with the CMK), aws_s3_bucket_versioning (enabled on datalake), and aws_s3_bucket_lifecycle_configuration: landing/ expire 30d; bronze/ transition STANDARD_IA 30d then expire 90d; lineage/ and quality/ expire 90d; athena-results expire all objects 14d; abort incomplete multipart uploads after 7d on both; audit/ INTENTIONALLY exempt from any expiry (durable tracking record, with a comment saying so).
Create infra/terraform/glue.tf: six aws_glue_catalog_database — landing, bronze, silver, canonical, gold, audit (names ocbc_poc_dev_* per §2.3).

Create infra/terraform/iam.tf: emr_serverless_job_role (least-privilege: the two bucket ARNs +/*, the six Glue DBs/tables, KMS encrypt/decrypt on the CMK, logs:CreateLogStream/PutLogEvents on the emr log group ARN +:* — NO s3:*, NO logs:*) and step_functions_role (EMR Serverless StartJobRun/GetJobRun/CancelJobRun on the specific app ARN, iam:PassRole of the job role, and the CloudWatch Logs delivery actions SFN needs for logging_configuration which must be Resource='*' as a DOCUMENTED vended-logs exception). Trust policies restrict Principal to the respective service, condition on aws:SourceArn where practical.

Create infra/terraform/cloudwatch.tf: aws_cloudwatch_log_group.sfn (/aws/vendedlogs/states/ocbc-poc-dev-medallion-pipeline, retention_in_days=14, kms_key_id=the CMK arn) and aws_cloudwatch_log_group.emr (/aws/emr-serverless/ocbc-poc-dev, 14d, KMS).

Create infra/terraform/emr_serverless.tf: one aws_emrserverless_application type SPARK, release emr-7.x (Spark 3.5), auto_start_configuration enabled, auto_stop_configuration enabled idle_timeout_minutes=15, maximum_capacity cpu='8 vCPU'/memory='32 GB'/disk='200 GB', initial_capacity minimal/omitted. Comment that the job-run CloudWatch logging is attached via the Step Functions startJobRun payload, not on the application resource.

Create infra/terraform/stepfunctions.tf + an ASL template (e.g. infra/terraform/medallion.asl.json.tftpl): aws_sfn_state_machine with definition = templatefile(...) interpolating the EMR application id and job role ARN. ASL per §8: StartAt LandingToBronze; four Task states (emr-serverless:startJobRun.sync) with entryPoint = s3://.../src/jobs/<script>.py and entryPointArguments=['--run-id', <id from $$.Execution.Name + timestamp>, '--env', 'dev', '--all'] and configurationOverrides.monitoringConfiguration.cloudWatchLoggingConfiguration pointing at the emr log group; each stage Catch [States.ALL] -> the SINGLE shared PipelineFailed Fail state; terminal PipelineSucceeded Succeed. Add logging_configuration { level=ALL, include_execution_data=true, log_destination='${sfn log group arn}:*' } and role = SFN role. NO --job argument anywhere.

Create infra/terraform/athena.tf (aws_athena_workgroup ocbc-poc-dev-wg: result_configuration -> athena-results bucket + encryption_configuration SSE_KMS, enforce_workgroup_configuration=true, publish_cloudwatch_metrics_enabled=true, engine version Athena v3), outputs.tf (bucket names, KMS key arn/alias, EMR app id, state machine arn, Athena workgroup name, Glue DB names), and infra/terraform/README.md (deploy/teardown runbook stating NO terraform apply is run in this task).

Create sql/athena/: 00_setup_notes.md (Iceberg tables auto-register in Glue via the Spark jobs — no manual CREATE TABLE needed for Athena v3), 01_gold_customer_360.sql, 02_gold_daily_txn_summary.sql, 03_gold_account_balances.sql (columns matching the §6.4 mart schemas exactly), and 04_audit_run_history.sql selecting from ocbc_poc_dev_audit.pipeline_runs using table_name (NEVER table).

Create top-level README.md (one-paragraph pitch; mermaid + ASCII diagram of landing->bronze->silver->canonical->gold with the DQ-gate branch to a FAIL state and side-arrows to lineage/quality/audit prefixes and Athena on gold; prerequisites; the §13 local-only verification steps; an explicit 'verified locally vs. requires AWS' statement; and a pointer to infra/terraform/README.md) and docs/: architecture.md (full flow narrative + diagram), finops.md (serverless pay-per-use + auto-stop + capacity cap + lifecycle expiry + cost-allocation tags + Athena result expiry story), security.md (KMS CMK, Block Public Access, least-privilege IAM, and the SFN vended-logs Resource='*' documented exception), lineage_quality_observability.md (custom JSON lineage shape, DQ gate + quality JSON, structured logging + audit table), and pii_catalog.md (PII columns + per-column masking method mirroring §4 / schema_defs).
acceptance_criteria: infra/terraform/ contains versions, providers (with default_tags), variables, locals, kms, s3, glue, iam, emr_serverless, cloudwatch, stepfunctions, athena, outputs .tf files, the ASL .tftpl template, terraform.tfvars.example, and a README.
s3.tf enforces Block Public Access (all four flags true) and SSE-KMS on both buckets, applies the lifecycle rules per §9, and leaves audit/ exempt from expiry; glue.tf defines all six Glue databases.

The ASL template defines the four startJobRun.sync Task states, routes every stage's Catch [States.ALL] to a SINGLE shared PipelineFailed Fail state, passes entryPointArguments --run-id/--env dev/--all (no --job), and ends at PipelineSucceeded; iam.tf defines both the EMR job role and the SFN role with least-privilege (plus the documented vended-logs Resource='*' exception).
sql/athena/ contains 00_setup_notes.md + four .sql files whose columns match the §6.4 mart schemas and §7.3 audit schema; 04 uses table_name, never table.

README.md includes the medallion+canonical diagram with the DQ-gate FAIL branch, the local-only verification steps, and the explicit verified-locally-vs-requires-AWS statement; docs/ contains architecture, finops, security, lineage_quality_observability, and pii_catalog.
verification: terraform fmt/validate are SKIPPED (terraform not installed) — confirm valid HCL by inspection against design §8/§9; print 'SKIPPED: terraform not installed'
Inspect the ASL template and confirm 4 Task states + single PipelineFailed Fail state + PipelineSucceeded, entryPointArguments has --all and no --job
Inspect each sql/athena/*.sql and confirm column names match the §6.4 mart and §7.3 audit schemas (04 uses table_name)
python -m compileall src data scripts  (confirm the repo still byte-compiles cleanly after docs/infra added)
findings:
FEAT-003 complete. Verification: terraform fmt/validate SKIPPED (terraform not installed) -- HCL confirmed valid by inspection against design S8/S9; all 13 .tf files have balanced braces; locals.tf cross-refs resolve (iam roles <-> kms <-> emr app <-> sfn). ASL template medallion.asl.json.tftpl parses as valid JSON after stubbing the ${...} template vars: StartAt=LandingToBronze, exactly 4 Task states (startJobRun.sync), 1 shared PipelineFailed Fail state (every stage Catch[States.ALL]->PipelineFailed, 4 catches), 1 PipelineSucceeded Succeed; entryPointArguments carries --all x4 and --job x0. sql/athena: 00_setup_notes.md + 01-04; gold columns match S6.4 (customer_360 first_name_masked/active_account_count/last_txn_at; daily_txn_summary debit_total/credit_total/net_amount; account_balances customer_token/account_type); 04 uses table_name only (the word 'table' appears solely in comments). `python -m compileall src data scripts` exits 0 (repo still byte-compiles after docs/infra added).

=== DESIGN DECISIONS / DEVIATIONS (FEAT-003) ===
1. EMR release_label pinned to 'emr-7.5.0' (concrete 7.x = Spark 3.5) rather than a wildcard, since Terraform requires a literal release label. Bump as newer 7.x ships.
2. Athena engine_version string set to 'Athena engine version 3' (the exact value the aws_athena_workgroup resource expects for v3).
3. Athena result output_location uses a 'query-results/' sub-prefix inside the athena-results bucket; the bucket-wide 14d lifecycle expiry covers it.
4. KMS key policy also grants logs.<region>.amazonaws.com use of the CMK (scoped by kms:EncryptionContext aws:logs:arn) so the two KMS-encrypted CloudWatch log groups can be written -- without this the encrypted log groups fail at create/write time. This is beyond the literal S9 text but is required for the documented KMS-encrypted log groups to function; noted here as a cross-FEAT seam for deploy-time.
5. EMR job-role trust conditions on aws:SourceArn = the EMR application ARN (confused-deputy guard) as S9 suggested 'where practical'; SFN role PassRole conditions on iam:PassedToService=emr-serverless.amazonaws.com.
6. Glue DBs created via a single for_each over local.glue_databases (keys landing/bronze/silver/canonical/gold/audit) -> outputs.glue_databases is a layer->name map.

=== CROSS-FEAT SEAMS NOTED (for runtime / a later FEAT) ===
- Deploy must sync the repo's src/ to s3://<datalake_bucket>/src/ so the ASL entryPoint s3://.../src/jobs/<script>.py resolves (documented in infra/terraform/README.md and top-level README). locals.jobs_s3_base is the single source of that prefix and is also an output.
- FEAT-002 finding #3: the Spark jobs need PIPELINE_ACCOUNT_ID (or equivalent) to build the real datalake bucket name at runtime; the bucket name Terraform creates is ocbc-poc-dev-datalake-<account_id> (locals.datalake_bucket). These must agree. The ASL does NOT currently inject PIPELINE_ACCOUNT_ID/PIPELINE_MASK_SALT as Spark env/conf -- a later FEAT wiring real job submission should thread the account id and mask salt into the startJobRun payload (sparkSubmitParameters --conf spark.emr-serverless... or EMR env). Flagged, not implemented (baseline scope).
- The SFN role's vended-logs statement is Resource='*' by AWS requirement (documented exception in security.md); harmless for least-privilege review as that role touches no data.
